wikipediaBodyRead.title: Jehoram
wikipediaBodyRead.locator: 同名人物の一覧L108–112、特にL111の「Jehoram of Judah」。
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: L108–112 says Jehoram is a name shared by several Tanakh figures, including separate Israel and Judah kings; the Judah entry is the relevant possible match for the son of Jehoshaphat in WEB 1KI22:50.
